text: Bulk attachment delete and detach confirmations pass one formatted list of names. The historical string bundle had one %S placeholder, so the repair joins all names with newline and passes that list as the sole substitution argument. The later Fluent code keeps the same list as its attachments value. This formatting contract does not prove saved-file coverage or change asynchronous modification and cancellation behavior. No prompt or attachment test ran.
title: Bulk attachment confirmation passes one newline-separated name list
